main_text.l: ribus, post tot enatas novas, veteres re-
oris, in hac etiam balbescente fenestute,
præstandi (quæ fortassis ab his exigi fas
est, qui assidui sunt in hac palæstra)
facultas siqua olim inerat, quum in his
(& quantilla tum illa!) exoleta jam prorsus,
le qua libraria qua domestica, tædium,

page.notes: The text is set in italic type throughout; the italic type is shown as plain text. Some words are uncertain in the scan (for example "fenestute", "balbescente", "studiis") and were transcribed as printed. The last line "vel" stands at the right margin.
